intro: The northwest gives you the best radio propagation in China. Flat gravel desert, no vegetation, no electrical noise and enormous distances between towns mean VHF travels further here than anywhere except the plateau. It is also the most linguistically interesting part of the broadcast band, with Uyghur, Kazakh, Mongolian and Mandarin services all sharing the dial, and at night the medium wave band fills with signals from Central Asia and Russia.
introz: 西北拥有中国最好的无线电传播条件。平坦的砾石戈壁、没有植被、没有电气噪声，加上城镇之间的巨大距离，让 VHF 在这里传得比除高原以外任何地方都远。这里也是广播波段上语言最丰富的地区，维吾尔语、哈萨克语、蒙古语和普通话共用同一频段，入夜后中波里挤满来自中亚和俄罗斯的信号。

stations.n: 公众对讲机 Ch 19 — convoy channel
stations.z: 公众对讲机 19 频道 · 车队频道
stations.d: The Duku Highway, the Xinjiang–Tibet route and the Hexi Corridor all see organised self-drive groups running 409 MHz walkie-talkies. On open desert the 0.5 W limit performs far better than it does in a city — several kilometres is normal with line of sight.
stations.dz: 独库公路、新藏线和河西走廊都有成队的自驾团体使用 409 MHz 公众对讲机。在开阔戈壁上，0.5 瓦的表现远好于城市——视野通畅时几公里是常态。

stations.z: 公众对讲机 20 频道 · 备频

stations.n: 公众对讲机 Ch 1 — truckers and everyone else
stations.z: 公众对讲机 1 频道 · 货车与其他人
stations.d: Long-haul truck drivers on the G30 and G315 use the low channels. Road and weather information, if you can pick it out.
stations.dz: 连霍高速和 315 国道上的长途货车司机用低信道。如果能听出来，路况和天气信息很有价值。

stations.z: 2 米 FM 呼叫 · 距离极远
stations.d: Desert line of sight is remarkable. From any ridge along the Tianshan foothills or on the Gobi flats, a handheld reaches distances that feel implausible. There are very few repeaters, so simplex is the mode that matters.
stations.dz: 戈壁的视距传播非常惊人。在天山山麓的任何山脊或戈壁平地上，手台的覆盖距离会让人难以置信。这里中继台极少，所以直通才是重点。

stations.n: Repeater outputs — Ürümqi and Lanzhou only
stations.z: 中继台下行 · 仅乌鲁木齐与兰州
stations.d: The larger cities have machines. Between them, assume nothing.
stations.dz: 较大的城市有中继台，城市之间不要有任何指望。

stations.d: The main gateway to Central Asia, with routes west that you will not hear anywhere else in China.
stations.dz: 通往中亚的主要门户，往西的航线在中国其他地方听不到。

stations.d: Long-haul traffic between Europe and East Asia crosses this airspace. From the desert with no terrain in the way, enroute reception is superb.
stations.dz: 欧洲与东亚之间的远程航班穿过这片空域。在毫无地形遮挡的戈壁上，航路频率的接收效果极佳。

stations.d: Scan the airband in AM near Dunhuang, Kashgar and Jiayuguan. Regional fields are quiet but the occasional movement is easy to follow.
stations.dz: 在敦煌、喀什和嘉峪关附近用 AM 扫航空波段。区域机场很清静，但偶尔的起降很容易跟上。

stations.d: The conventional Lanzhou–Ürümqi railway carries enormous freight volumes through the Hexi Corridor and still uses analog 450 MHz dispatch. Where the road runs alongside the track for hundreds of kilometres, this is genuinely good listening.
stations.dz: 普速兰新铁路承担着穿越河西走廊的巨大货运量，仍使用 450 MHz 模拟调度。公路与铁路并行数百公里的路段，收听效果确实不错。

stations.z: 无线列调 · 配对频段
多语言调频 · 扫 87–108 MHz
stations.d: Xinjiang People's Broadcasting runs services in Uyghur, Kazakh, Kyrgyz, Mongolian and Mandarin. Sweeping the band slowly across the region is one of the more genuinely interesting things you can do with a radio in China, entirely independent of whether you understand the languages.
stations.dz: 新疆人民广播电台有维吾尔语、哈萨克语、柯尔克孜语、蒙古语和汉语的频率。在这一带慢慢扫一遍波段，是在中国用电台能做的最有意思的事情之一，跟你是否听得懂完全无关。

stations.d: Essential on the Duku Highway, which closes with snow for much of the year. Frequencies change between valleys — sweep rather than memorise.
stations.dz: 在独库公路上必备——这条路一年中很长时间因积雪封闭。频率随河谷变化，请整段搜索而不要死记。

stations.n: Medium wave at night — Central Asia and Russia
stations.z: 夜间中波 · 中亚与俄罗斯
stations.d: One of the best medium wave locations in the world. No noise floor, and signals arrive from Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Russia, Mongolia, Iran and India. Remember the 9 kHz spacing used across Asia.
stations.dz: 全球最好的中波接收地点之一。没有底噪，能收到哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦、俄罗斯、蒙古、伊朗和印度的信号。注意亚洲通用的 9 kHz 间隔。

stations.d: China's time station on 2.5, 5, 10 and 15 MHz, plus international shortwave broadcasting from every direction. The desert at night is as good as HF listening gets.
stations.dz: 中国授时台在 2.5、5、10、15 MHz，此外还有来自各个方向的国际短波广播。夜间的戈壁是短波收听的最佳环境。

stations.d: Flat desert with a 360 degree horizon and no interference. Close to ideal.
stations.dz: 四周地平线无遮挡、毫无干扰的平坦戈壁，接近理想条件。

stations.n: Jiuquan launch site — do not go looking
stations.z: 酒泉发射中心 · 不要去找频率
stations.d: The Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre is in this region. Launch communications are military and encrypted. Unlike Cape Canaveral in Florida, there is nothing to monitor and attempting to would be unwise. Watch a launch if you get the chance and leave the radio in your bag.
stations.dz: 酒泉卫星发射中心就在这一区域。发射通信属于军方且已加密。与佛罗里达的卡纳维拉尔角不同，这里没有可监听的内容，尝试监听也很不明智。有机会就去看一次发射，把电台留在包里。
